title: Three Possible Values of the Quadratic Residue Symbol
statement: For any natural numbers $N$ and $A$, define the quadratic residue symbol modulo $N$ to be $0$ when $A$ is not coprime to $N$, $1$ when the residue of $A$ modulo $N$ is a square, and $-1$ otherwise. This symbol is one of $0$, $1$, or $-1$.
